name: Newport Country Club
centre_source: Wikipedia 41.462, -71.347 and OSM's course point 41.46219, -71.34694 (via courses.opengolfapi.org); box centre nudged ~90 m west; box 3.4 x 3.0 km
par_note: card par 72 (36-36, GolfPass); championship par 70 (holes 1 and 12 as par 4s; 2024 U.S. Senior Open, nines reversed)
architects: William F. Davis (nine holes 1894; 18 holes 1897 or 1899)
A. W. Tillinghast (1921 plan, remodel and seven new holes west of Harrison Avenue, work dated 1923 by the USGA)
Ron Forse (restoration from 1995; USGA dates it 2005)
renovations: Ron Forse restoration of Tillinghast greens and bunkers, from 1995 (2005 per USGA)
500+ yd of tees added over about two decades before 2024 (USGA)
green restoration under superintendent Charles Coen (from 2015); 5 miles of drainage pipe
no construction since 2020 found (USGA setup changes only for 2024)
notable: one of the five founding clubs of the USGA (1894); Theodore Havemeyer the USGA's first president
first U.S. Amateur (Charles Blair Macdonald) and first U.S. Open (Horace Rawlins), October 1895
2020 U.S. Senior Open postponed (COVID-19); 2024 U.S. Senior Open (Richard Bland, playoff over Hiroyuki Fujita), 7,024 yd par 70, nines reversed
Golf Digest: America's Second 100 Greatest #145 (2025-26), #1 in Rhode Island
video_games: No licensed appearance found. A fan recreation, 'Newport CC LIDAR' by Laboroflove, for The Golf Club 2019 (golfsimulatorforum.com, 2022-11-14).

tees.name: White/Blue
tees.note: four holes longer than White: don't build

default_tee: White (recommended, 6,204 yd, 70.7/122): Blue, the 4.1 default by name, is the forward set here (5,506); White is the single set closest to 6,300 (as at TPC Boston). Developer to confirm.
theme: coastal (Highland Links) as the starting point, or a new `newport` theme: tawny unirrigated fairways, olive-gold native fescue, coarse sand, grey-blue sea, few trees, low shrub thickets
special_ground: native fescue / native-grass rough beside the mown rough (rough_band_m as at Highland Links), e.g. left of 2, right of 3, left of 17, both sides of 9
shrub thickets (one reviewer calls them gorse) right of 2 and both sides of 7 and 8; not the penal gorse surface unless the developer wants it
water: Rhode Island Sound / Atlantic beyond Ocean Drive (left of 4; ocean close to 3); a creek down the left of 12; a hazard down the left of 16 and a wet burn at its green; a hidden water hazard left of 17 (hole name 'Pond'); all red (standing default)
out_of_bounds: the OSM course boundary; reviews: left of 2, left of 3, left of 11, right of 16 (a brick wall); Harrison Avenue splits the course (holes 2-8 west of it)
roads: Harrison Avenue crosses the course (between 1 and 2, and between 8 and 9); Ocean Drive along the shore; 10 plays over two clubhouse drives

lidar.bare_earth: USGS 3DEP 1 m, 2022 USGS Lidar: RI Statewide (RI_Statewide_D22), tile x30y460 (name not checked)
lidar.canopy: NOAA Data Access Viewer point cloud, dataset 9981 (same survey), all classes (no vegetation class; trees from class 1 with OSM buildings removed, as at Triggs)

imagery: USDA NAIP via the USGS National Map (newest year the service holds)
osm_coverage: the course is in OSM (opengolfapi credits its course point to OSM); holes, greens and tees unknown until the export
scorecard_status: complete third-party per-hole card (GolfPass: 7 sets, par, men's and women's stroke index, ratings); conflicts with Wikipedia's undated card; club card not online
open_questions: Default tee: White (6,204) instead of the forward Blue (5,506)? Recommendation: White
Scorecard: GolfPass and Wikipedia disagree hole by hole; recommendation: build on GolfPass, swap in the printed card if a photo turns up
Par: card 72 or championship 70? Recommendation: card 72
Theme: coastal or a new newport theme? Recommendation: new newport theme from coastal (tawny fairways)
Shrub thickets: rough/shrubs, not the penal gorse surface? Recommendation: not gorse
Logo: hickory club and gutty ball over waves (1895)
